summary: Tested 2 assertions (VAL-RECOMP-002, VAL-RECOMP-003) across 3 test functions: all 3 tests passed. VAL-RECOMP-002 confirms the compiler-in-the-loop correctly captures stderr from failed compilations and feeds it back to the LLM for iterative refinement, resulting in successful recompilation on the second attempt. VAL-RECOMP-003 confirms the engine gracefully terminates at the configured max retry limit, produces a structured failure report with full attempt history, and does not invoke later pipeline phases when compilation fails for all compilers.
